arxiv-2206-09013.title: X-ray performance of critical-angle transmission grating prototypes for the Arcus mission
arxiv-2206-09013.creator: Ralf K. Heilmann, Alexander R. Bruccoleri, Vadim Burwitz, Casey deRoo, Alan Garner, Hans Moritz Günther, Eric M. Gullikson, Gisela Hartner, Ed Hertz, Andreas Langmeier, Thomas Müller, Surangkhana Rukdee, Thomas Schmidt, Randall K. Smith, Mark L. Schattenburg
arxiv-2206-09013.description: Abstract Arcus is a proposed soft x-ray grating spectrometer Explorer. It aims to explore cosmic feedback by mapping hot gases within and between galaxies and galaxy clusters and characterizing jets and winds from supermassive black holes, and to investigate the dynamics of protoplanetary discs and stellar accretion.

arxiv-2212-02495.title: Balanced Binary Tree Schemes for Computing Zernike Radial Polynomials
arxiv-2212-02495.creator: Hong-Yan Zhang, Yu Zhou, Zhi-Qiang Feng
arxiv-2212-02495.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Hong-Yan Zhang, Yu Zhou, Zhi-Qiang Feng. Zernike radial polynomials (ZRP) play a significant role in application areas such as optics design, imaging systems, and image processing systems. Currently, there are two kinds of numerical schemes for computing the ZRP automatically with computer programs: one is based on the definition in which the factorial operations may lead to the overflow problem and the high order derivatives are troublesome, and the other is based on recursion which is either unstable or with high computational complexity.

arxiv-2305-01363.title: Coalescence of bubbles in a viscoelastic liquid
arxiv-2305-01363.creator: Alexandros T. Oratis, Vincent Bertin, Jacco H. Snoeijer
arxiv-2305-01363.description: Abstract When two bubbles submerged in a liquid are brought closely together, the intermediate liquid film separating the bubbles begins to drain. Once the film ruptures, the bubbles coalesce and form a neck that expands with time. The dynamics of the neck growth are well understood in the context of pure, Newtonian liquids.

arxiv-2307-11203.title: The Structure of Turbulence in Unsteady Flow over Urban Canopies
arxiv-2307-11203.creator: Weiyi Li 1, Marco G. Giometto 1
arxiv-2307-11203.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Weiyi Li 1, Marco G. Giometto 1. The topology of turbulent coherent structures is known to regulate the transport of energy, mass, and momentum in the atmospheric boundary layer (ABL). While previous research has primarily focused on characterizing the structure of turbulence in stationary ABL flows, real-world scenarios frequently deviate from stationarity, giving rise to nuanced and poorly understood changes in the turbulence geometry and associated transport mechanisms.

arxiv-2404-09394.title: Fluorite-type materials in the monolayer limit
arxiv-2404-09394.creator: Shota Ono, Ravinder Pawar
arxiv-2404-09394.description: Abstract The 2H, 1T, and their distorted structures are known as prototype structures of A ​ B 2 AB_{2} monolayers. Here, we study a puckered structure that is truncated from the (110) surface of fluorite-type materials. 53 fluorite-type materials are investigated based on first-principles approach.

arxiv-2409-16669.title: Biglobal linear stability analysis of a ducted 2D premixed flame: intrinsic thermoacoustic mode and role of exceptional point
arxiv-2409-16669.creator: Lu Chen 1, 2, Yu Lv 1, 3
arxiv-2409-16669.description: Abstract In this work, we aim to establish a detailed description of the physical mechanisms of intrinsic thermoacoustic modes and their interplay with duct acoustic modes. Tsisbiglobal linear stability of an anchored laminar flame in an acoustic duct is carried out by exploiting the linearized compressible reactive flow equations.

arxiv-2505-08069.title: Process Tomography for Clifford Unitaries
arxiv-2505-08069.creator: Timothy Skaras, Paul Ginsparg
arxiv-2505-08069.description: Abstract We present an algorithm for performing quantum process tomography on an unknown n n -qubit unitary C C from the Clifford group. Our algorithm uses Bell basis measurements to deterministically learn C C with 4 ​ n + 3 4n+3 queries, which is the asymptotically optimal query complexity.

arxiv-2510-25497.title: Right for the Right Reasons: Avoiding Reasoning Shortcuts via Prototypical Neurosymbolic AI
arxiv-2510-25497.creator: Luca Andolfi, Eleonora Giunchiglia
arxiv-2510-25497.description: Abstract Neurosymbolic AI is growing in popularity thanks to its ability to combine neural perception and symbolic reasoning in end-to-end trainable models. However, recent findings reveal these are prone to shortcut reasoning, i.e., to learning unindented concepts–or neural predicates–which exploit spurious correlations to satisfy the symbolic constraints.

arxiv-2511-04592.title: The Pre-Outburst Properties of the FU Ori Object HBC 722
arxiv-2511-04592.creator: Gregory J. Herczeg (沈雷歌), Bo Reipurth
arxiv-2511-04592.description: Abstract FU Ori outbursts are thought to play an important role in stellar assembly and the evolution of protoplanetary disks. However, the progenitor young stellar objects are largely uncharacterized. We obtained a low-resolution optical spectrum of HBC 722 before its FU Ori outburst as part of a survey of young stellar objects in the North America Nebula.

arxiv-2511-22242.title: TTSnap: Test-Time Scaling of Diffusion Models via Noise-Aware Pruning
arxiv-2511-22242.creator: Qingtao Yu, Changlin Song, Minghao Sun, Zhengyang Yu, Vinay Kumar Verma, Soumya Roy, Sumit Negi, Hongdong Li, Dylan Campbell
arxiv-2511-22242.description: Abstract A prominent approach to test-time scaling for text-to-image diffusion models formulates the problem as a search over multiple noise seeds, selecting the one that maximizes a certain image-reward function. The effectiveness of this strategy heavily depends on the number and diversity of noise seeds explored.

pmc-10628634.title: Dissemination and characteristics of carbapenem-resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae in nine district hospitals in southwestern China
pmc-10628634.creator: Yonghong Wang, Yan Ouyang, Xiuyu Xu, Shan Sun, Xiaolang Tian, Hang Liu, Yun Xia
pmc-10628634.description: BackgroundCarbapenem-resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae (CRKP) is epidemically transmitted globally, but few studies focused on the prevalence in district-level hospitals. In this study, we investigated CRKP strains collected from nine district hospitals from September 2019 to September 2020, aiming to determine the resistance mechanisms, virulence profiles, and molecular epidemiological characteristics of CRKP in district hospitals in Southwest China.

pmc-10657474.title: Serine peptidase Vpr forms enzymatically active fibrils outside Bacillus bacteria revealed by cryo-EM
pmc-10657474.creator: Yijia Cheng, Jianting Han, Meinai Song, Shuqin Zhang, Qin Cao
pmc-10657474.description: Bacteria develop a variety of extracellular fibrous structures crucial for their survival, such as flagella and pili. In this study, we use cryo-EM to identify protein fibrils surrounding lab-cultured Bacillus amyloiquefaciens and discover an unreported fibril species in addition to the flagellar fibrils. These previously unknown fibrils are composed of Vpr, an extracellular serine peptidase.

pmc-10712104.title: Identifying the genes involved in the egg-carrying ovigerous hair development of the female blue crab Callinectes sapidus: transcriptomic and genomic expression analyses
pmc-10712104.creator: Tao Wang, Tsvetan Bachvaroff, J Sook Chung
pmc-10712104.description: BackgroundCrustacean female sex hormone (CFSH) controls gradually developing adult female-specific morphological features essential for mating and brood care. Specifically, ovigerous hairs are developed during the prepuberty molt cycle of the blue crab Callinectes sapidus that are essential for carrying the eggs until they finish development.

pmc-11271804.title: Drug resistance profiles of Mycobacterium tuberculosis clinical isolates by genotype MTBDRplus line probe assay in Zambia: findings and implications

pmc-11271804.description: BackgroundThe emergence of drug resistance is a threat to global tuberculosis (TB) elimination goals. pmc-12570368.description: SummaryNeurodevelopmental disorders often involve both motor and cognitive impairments, linked to the maturation of cerebral and cerebellar regions. This study reveals that during early postnatal development, ameboid microglia infiltrate the cerebellar white matter via the fourth ventricular zone, in parallel with similar activity in the cerebral white matter.

pmc-12644159.title: Molecular pathogenesis of the schwannomatosis genes and genetic testing strategies
pmc-12644159.creator: Miriam J Smith
pmc-12644159.description: The three major schwannomatosis genes, NF2, LZTR1 and SMARCB1, are all located within approximately 9 megabases on chromosome 22 and cause three genetically distinct conditions with significant clinical phenotypic overlap. All forms of schwannomatosis predispose to the development of multiple schwannomas, but display differences in tumour location and long-term prognosis.

pmc-13114312.title: An Interpretable Multimodal Machine-Learning Model for Non-Invasive Preoperative Glioma Grading
pmc-13114312.creator: Xianfeng Rao, Min Yang, Hao Chen, Guanhao Li, Li Wu, Liudong Gong, Mingchun Yang, Haiyang Wang, Ye Ding, Guanxi Chen, Xianjun Rao, Na Zhang, Xiaoxiong Wang, Lei Teng
pmc-13114312.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Simple SummaryGlioma grading before surgery is essential because treatment planning and expected outcomes differ greatly between low-grade and high-grade tumors. In routine practice, grading often depends on postoperative pathology, while preoperative imaging and symptoms alone may be uncertain. We developed and internally validated a machine-learning model that combines readily available preoperative information, including clinical symptoms, standard imaging features, and metabolic measurements from magnetic resonance spectroscopy.

pmc-13272076.title: A plasma N-acetyl amino acid panel for type 2 diabetes discrimination built by targeted LC–MS/MS: A case–control study
pmc-13272076.creator: Shusi Ding, Zhanxiong Xie, Daqiu Chen, Xiaomai Huang, Qiutong Wu, Lemin Zheng, Shanghua Xu, Shunxiang Luo
pmc-13272076.description: BackgroundType 2 diabetes (T2D) is characterized by profound metabolic disturbances, yet clinically actionable biomarkers beyond conventional glycaemic indices remain limited. N-acetyl amino acids (NAcAAs) are emerging metabolites linked to amino acid metabolism and acetylation status, but their quantitative profile and diagnostic relevance in T2D have not been systematically defined.
